projects.title: Distributed database
projects.description:
A linearizable, fault-tolerant, sharded key-value distributed database with dynamic load balancing.

- Implemented distributed consensus on a shared log of commands via the multi-instance Paxos algorithm.
- Supported operations across different shards and automatically redistributed shards when servers leave/join.
- Ensured correctness and liveliness of the distributed database despite server failures, network failures, or network delays.

Technologies used: Java, Lombok, Apache Commons Lang, Google Guava, JUnit

projects.title: Project Rakan
projects.description:
A web-based application that analyzes gerrymandering to help detect illegal manipulation of U.S. voters.

- Led the back-end team in designing and implementing the product architecture, code, and documentation. Assisted PM in designing an API contract and maintaining it.
- Practiced consistent code reviews, pull requests, and upheld good Git practices with the team.
- Implemented a fully automated and comprehensive test suite using Google Test framework.

Technologies used: C/C++, Google Test, CMake, Docker
